# GHINOVA

> GHINOVA offers practical Python and AI learning resources, beginner-friendly tutorials, self-paced workshops, live training, and custom AI assistant development.

Official website: https://ghinwafakih.github.io/ghinova/
Digital shop: https://ghinwafakih.github.io/ghinova/shop.html

## Free learning resources
- [Build your first OpenClaw AI agent](https://ghinwafakih.github.io/ghinova/guides/openclaw-first-agent/): introduction to agents, skills, tool permissions and safe read-only workflows.
- [Build a Python PDF chatbot](https://ghinwafakih.github.io/ghinova/guides/pdf-chatbot-python/): practical document question-answering tutorial.
- [Evaluate a RAG chatbot](https://ghinwafakih.github.io/ghinova/guides/evaluate-rag-chatbot-python/): introduction to retrieval evaluation.

## Workshops and services
- [Digital shop](https://ghinwafakih.github.io/ghinova/shop.html): free labs, paid workshops, and course listings. Check individual pages for current prices and availability.
- [AI services and training](https://ghinwafakih.github.io/ghinova/): custom AI assistants, RAG, GraphRAG, and 1-to-1 lessons.

## About
GHINOVA's public-facing instructor name is Ghinwa. Its content focuses on practical AI education and knowledge-driven applications.
